models.notes: Streaming English zipformer (20M parameters), icefall LibriSpeech model exported for sherpa-onnx. Smallest and fastest; default live recogniser. min_ram_gb is an estimate to be tuned in Task 13. Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-streaming-zipformer-en-20M-2023-02-17.tar.bz2 (sherpa-onnx 'asr-models' release). SHA-256 and size computed by downloading the file twice; both runs matched and the size equals GitHub's published asset size.

Larger streaming English zipformer (icefall LibriSpeech, 2023-06-26) for machines with more memory. min_ram_gb is an estimate to be tuned in Task 13. Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-streaming-zipformer-en-2023-06-26.tar.bz2 (sherpa-onnx 'asr-models' release). SHA-256 and size computed by downloading the file twice; both runs matched and the size equals GitHub's published asset size.
